pages.text: There was one swing in the yard. The children lined up behind it.
"I want to swing too!" Bobo rose onto tiptoe at the end of the line.
Bobo stamped impatiently. "I want a turn now."
Lala had just got off the swing. Bobo quickly took the seat.
Bobo held the ropes and spun around. The swing twisted sharply sideways.
The two ropes twisted together. The swing stuck high up.
Nobody could use it. The children waiting behind looked at Bobo.
Teacher Bau untwisted the ropes. "The swing can carry only one person at a time."
Bobo stood at the back of the line. In front, the children took turns swinging and getting off.
At last, Bobo's turn. Up, up toward the sky went Bobo, toes almost reaching the leaves.
